stem: What happens next in this passage after “It was slow and messy.”?
options: The guide explained that technology had changed, but the lighthouse still helped people understand maritime history.
One afternoon, her grandfather asked her to make tea with him.
The guide asked them what had changed and what had not.
The guide explained that printing technology once changed the spread of knowledge.
